paragraphs: In Kiddushin 25a they did not come to Rav Chisda’s lecture. He said to Rav Hamnuna: “Go and excommunicate them.” They said to him: “Not Hamnuna but Karnuna.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Kiddushin 25a has לפירקיה, supporting “lecture” for the supplied לפיקריה. צנעינהו is rendered “excommunicate them” following the episode’s interpreted sense; that lexical interpretation is distinct from a claim of printed-letter correction history.

Rashi on Kiddushin 25a explicitly explains צנעינהו as respectful language of exclusion: telling a scholar to shut himself in at home. This supports the ban interpretation here; it does not establish printed-letter correction history.
